rust_summary: ordered mod-owned HUD and screen textures (`native_gui_texture_register`, `native_gui_texture_create`, `native_gui_texture`, `native_gui_texture_write`).
doc_summary: Register a same-device non-sRGB Rgba8Unorm or Bgra8Unorm texture, or filterable Rgba16Float, and append native_gui_texture(batch, &texture, [x,y,w,h], [u0,v0,u1,v1], argb, nine_slice) before preparing the GUI batch. Creation provides TEXTURE_BINDING | RENDER_ATTACHMENT | COPY_DST. Keep the cloneable NativeGuiTexture; later redraw its target in WorldPrePost, before the prepared GUI samples it. Do not append commands retroactively from WorldPrePost. Coordinates are GUI units. Tint is straight-alpha ARGB; UVs are normalized, with optional NativeGuiNineSlice borders ordered left/top/right/bottom. Draws preserve translucent order, clipping and blur boundaries. Registrations cache their bind group. Live handles and prepared batches retain registrations: at most 64, sides at most min(4096, device limit), and 128 MiB including mip levels. Drop unused handles/batches to release capacity. Reload or device loss invalidates handles; register again on the new renderer. Resizing alone does not invalidate them. Invalid or foreign handles return false without appending. native_gui_texture_write(&texture, [x,y], [width,height], bytes) uploads tightly packed texels to a current-renderer COPY_DST texture: 4 bytes per texel for RGBA/BGRA8, 8 for RGBA16Float, at most 16 MiB per upload. Invalid dimensions, bounds, lengths, handles or usage return NativeGuiTextureError without a GPU write. Bundles need `hooks`: @API:gui_textures@.
